about.an-independent-nonpartisan-record-: An independent, nonpartisan record of what was announced at each polling unit — documented, verified and published by ordinary Nigerians.
about.elections-are-won-at-the-polling: Elections are won at the polling unit, then at collation. When numbers can change on the way up, trust collapses. So every report here is photographed, signed on the observer's own phone and chained on a public ledger — and a count is trusted only when independent observers at the same place agree, backed by GPS and matching venue photos.
about.hawkeye-does-not-declare-winners-a: Hawkeye does not declare winners, and its tallies are not official results — those come only from INEC. It is a record built to aid scrutiny, unaffiliated with INEC, any party, candidate or campaign.

faq.anyone-with-a-nigerian-mobile-number: Anyone with a Nigerian mobile number and a phone with a camera and GPS. Verify your number once, then report from the polling unit where you observe the count. No accreditation, membership or payment needed.
faq.can-a-report-be-edited-or: Can a report be edited or deleted afterwards?
faq.can-one-person-submit-multiple-repor: Can one person submit multiple reports with different SIM cards?
faq.each-device-carries-a-fingerprint-an: Each device carries a fingerprint, and one device can report each race only once — no matter how many numbers are registered on it. Independent reports must come from genuinely different people on different phones.
faq.how-do-i-get-alerts-for: How do I get alerts for races I care about?
faq.how-is-my-verification-code-sent: How is my verification code sent?
faq.is-hawkeye-official-are-these-the: Is Hawkeye official? Are these the real election results?
faq.it-is-hashed-one-way-scrambled: It is hashed (one-way scrambled) before storage and is never published or shared. It exists solely so one number equals one observer.
faq.map-your-unit-before-election-day: map your unit before election day
faq.my-polling-unit-doesn-t-appear: My polling unit doesn't appear near me. Why?
faq.no-gallery-uploads-ever-both-photos: No gallery uploads, ever. Both photos — the EC8A results sheet and the venue — are captured in-app and GPS-stamped on the spot. This is what makes a Hawkeye report hard to fake from somewhere else.
faq.no-hawkeye-is-an-independent-communi: No. Hawkeye is an independent, community-run transparency initiative. The tallies shown here are crowd-verified evidence of what was announced at individual polling units — the official results of any election are only those declared by INEC.
faq.tap-any-question-to-expand-it: Tap any question to expand it.
faq.what-happens-to-my-phone-number: What happens to my phone number?
faq.when-independent-observers-at-the-sa: When independent observers at the same unit submit matching counts — backed by GPS, matching venue photos and automatic reading of the sheet. Until then a count stays visibly marked as reported or provisional.
faq.why-must-photos-be-taken-live: Why must photos be taken live? Can I upload from my gallery?
faq.your-one-time-code-arrives-free: Your one-time code arrives free of charge on the channel you choose at sign-up — Telegram or WhatsApp. Open the link shown there, confirm your contact (it must match the number you typed), and the code arrives instantly. Race alerts reach you the same way, and in the app's notifications feed.
guide.everything-you-need-to-do-before: Everything you need to do — before, during and after the count at your polling unit.
guide.geofenced-units-only-accept-report: Geofenced units only accept reports from people standing there.
guide.good-light-no-glare-no-fingers: Good light, no glare, no fingers over the figures column.
guide.hard-rules-the-app-enforces-these: Hard rules — the app enforces these
guide.if-the-app-warns-the-photo: If the app warns the photo is blurry or washed out, retake it.
guide.live-photos-only-no-gallery-upload: Live photos only; no gallery uploads, no screenshots.
guide.one-report-per-election-per-pollin: One report per election per polling unit per observer — and one per election per device, regardless of how many SIMs it holds.
guide.open-the-report-page-once-on: Open the report page once on Wi-Fi so it saves to your phone, grant camera and location permission, and charge enough to last through the evening count.
guide.point-the-camera-at-the-whole: Point the camera at the whole sheet — the scanner outlines it and captures automatically when steady.
guide.reports-are-permanent-nothing-can-: Reports are permanent. Nothing can be edited or deleted after signing.
guide.take-a-separate-photo-of-the: Take a separate photo of the polling unit — the building, banner or surroundings. This lets the system confirm different observers stood at the same place.
guide.the-rules-that-keep-reports-honest: The Rules That Keep Reports Honest
guide.type-each-party-s-announced-figure: Type each party's announced figure exactly, then sign and submit while still at the unit. Photos expire if you wait, and your GPS must match where the photos were taken. Several elections may be counted at your unit the same day — submit one report per election, each with its own photos.
guide.voting-ends-then-the-presiding-off: Voting ends, then the presiding officer counts ballots publicly and fills in the EC8A result sheet for each election. This — the announcement — is the moment that matters.
how.a-ledger-nobody-can-quietly-edit: ⛓️ A ledger nobody can quietly edit
how.a-verified-phone-number-is-one: A verified phone number is one observer identity. Numbers are stored only as one-way hashes — never readable, never published.
how.each-photo-is-gps-stamped-at: Each photo is GPS-stamped at capture; the sheet, venue and submission positions must all agree, and photos expire within minutes.
how.each-report-is-signed-on-the: Each report is signed on the observer's phone with a key that never leaves it, then chained to the previous entry by cryptographic hash.
how.each-report-is-tagged-to-its: Each report is tagged to its races automatically — state, senatorial district and federal constituency come from the official register.
how.every-unit-also-has-an-approximate: Every unit also has an approximate area from open geographic data; reports or mapping fixes far outside it are rejected outright.
how.hawkeye-turns-thousands-of-ordinary-: Hawkeye turns thousands of ordinary phones into a network of independent witnesses. No single report is trusted on its own — trust is earned when separate people, provably at the same place, say the same thing.
how.map-your-unit-before-election-day: Map Your Unit Before Election Day
how.most-polling-units-have-no-verified: Most polling units have no verified GPS location. Stand at yours and pin it before the vote.
how.photos-are-captured-live-in-the: Photos are captured live in the app — the EC8A sheet is auto-detected, flattened and quality-checked (blur/glare) like a document scanner.
how.re-submitting-someone-else-s-photo: Re-submitting someone else's photo — or a near-identical copy — is detected and rejected by image fingerprinting.
how.tap-each-layer-to-see-how: Tap each layer to see how it works.
how.the-typed-counts-are-cross-checked: The typed counts are cross-checked against the digits machine-read from the sheet photograph itself.
how.units-without-one-accept-reports-but: Units without one accept reports, but the count stays visibly "location-unverified" until at least three independent observers' GPS positions cluster at the same spot.
how.venue-photos-from-different-observer: Venue photos from different observers are feature-matched to confirm they stood at the same physical place.
how.verify-your-phone-then-photograph-th: Verify your phone, then photograph the announced EC8A results sheet and the venue on election day. Your report is signed on your device and recorded permanently.
how.watch-the-leaderboard-live-and-subsc: Watch the leaderboard live, and subscribe to alerts for the presidential race, your state, senatorial district or constituency.

privacy.one-time-codes-they-expire-in: One-time codes — they expire in minutes and are deleted on use.

results.party-emblems-are-used-for-ident: Party emblems are used for identification only. Auto-refreshes every 30 seconds.
results.unopened-races-can-be-viewed-the: Unopened races can be viewed — they simply have no results yet.
support.always-confirm-the-address-after: Always confirm the address after pasting. Hawkeye will never message you asking for funds or seed phrases.
support.hawkeye-is-built-and-paid-for: Hawkeye is built and paid for by its founder — no political funding, no advertisers, no strings attached. If the work is useful to you, a donation helps cover the servers, phones and time that keep it running and independent.
terms.do-not-attempt-to-disrupt-overload: Do not attempt to disrupt, overload, reverse-engineer, or gain unauthorised access to the service.
terms.do-not-upload-unlawful-defamatory-: Do not upload unlawful, defamatory, or harassing content, or media you have no right to share.
terms.hawkeye-is-a-free-independent-nonp: Hawkeye is a free, independent, nonpartisan election-transparency tool. By using the website, mobile app, or any Hawkeye service, you agree to these terms. Last updated 13 July 2026.
terms.hawkeye-is-provided-as-is-without: Hawkeye is provided “as is”, without warranties of any kind. Crowd-reported data is partial and unofficial and may contain errors; it is offered for transparency and scrutiny, not as a definitive count. We do not guarantee uninterrupted or error-free service.
terms.hawkeye-may-publish-its-own-public: Hawkeye may publish its own public-service content (for example, election-integrity explainers and result summaries) to its official accounts on third-party platforms such as TikTok, Instagram, and Facebook, using those platforms' official APIs. Such posts are made only from Hawkeye's own accounts and are subject to the respective platform's terms. Hawkeye does not access, collect, or post to any third-party user's social-media account.
terms.never-put-yourself-at-risk-to: Never put yourself at risk to gather a report. Follow all applicable laws.
terms.official-election-results-are-thos: Official election results are those declared by INEC alone.
terms.one-verified-phone-number-is-one: One verified phone number is one observer identity. Do not attempt to create multiple identities, evade anti-fraud controls, or file duplicate or automated reports.
terms.submit-only-truthful-reports-of-wh: Submit only truthful reports of what you genuinely witnessed at a polling unit. Do not fabricate, alter, or misrepresent results, photos, or locations.
terms.to-the-maximum-extent-permitted-by: To the maximum extent permitted by law, Hawkeye and its operators are not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of, or inability to use, the service, or from reliance on any crowd-reported data.
